name: Blameless Error Notification
mechanism: Attribution Bias & Locus of Control Maintenance
blueprintProse:
Blameless error messages divide their content into three balanced components: an objective status description (30%), a technical cause statement (30%), and an immediate remediation pathway (40%). 
This approach is grounded in attribution theory and locus-of-control preservation. Accusatory error messages trigger frustration and defense mechanisms, often causing users to abandon the application. Framing errors as neutral system conditions paired with direct remediation links maintains user composure and workflow efficiency.
template: [System Process Interrupted: Objective statement of the halted state] [System Cause: The precise syntactic, network, or data discrepancy detected]. [Actionable Resolution: Provide an immediate executable path or remediation button to resume].

example.bland: Error 403: Invalid Submission You entered an incompatible JSON payload format. Correct your mistakes and resubmit the form.
example.optimized: JSON Schema Validation Halted The payload was missing the required "environment_id" string on line 42. Insert the project identifier to resume compilation. [View Documentation Reference] or [Auto-Fix Schema Formatting]
